sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the equipment inspection list I1, which must be performed 
on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.

The screw pump type is self priming positive displacement pump 
and is used for 
delivery of lubricating fluids. veyor elements are three spindles, each with a 
double pitch or circulating the lubricating oil two separate filling oil pump 
sets are provided one pump is driven by an AC motor during normal operation 
conditions. The second pump is equipped with DC motor for standby.

The first draft initiated and tested by eng. Khaled Abou Bakr, accepted by eng.
Abd El-Karem Mousa Ahmed: mechanical maintenance director,
approved by eng. Youssef Mahmoud Aly: 
General Director

ومعتمدة من قبل المهندس. محمد أسامة سليمان: مدير عام مراقبة الجودة بشركة HPGC 
ومنسق MPIS.

Safety fence 
 with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
